about_the_game:
This DLC lets you recreate a classic Victorian-style world, featuring grand mansions, towns with smoke rising from chimneys, and plazas adorned with cobblestone paths and fountains. It includes modular parts such as building walls and windows, decorative objects like benches, fences, fountains, and streetlights, as well as ready-to-use prefab buildings and sample town maps.
With over 450 included 3D stamps, you can freely construct detailed and atmospheric urban environments. Whether it's a noble's mansion, an academy, or a horror-themed Western-style town, this pack provides all you need to bring your Victorian architectural vision to life.

[Ultra Building Victorian Style] Contents
Total 3D Stamps: 558

- Buildings, Verandas, Roof Awnings: 346 (including variations and decorative elements)

- Rain Gutters: 8

- Rooms: 28 (includes different shapes and color variations)

- Props: 61 (doors, chimneys, wall decorations, extra rooms, etc.)

- Pavement Parts: 16

- Interior Parts: 43 (interior walls, columns, etc., with variations)

- Modular Parts for Combining: 7

- Prefabs: 48
